problem: nltl:hasDetachedStrut is an object property whose range is nltl:detachedStrutStructure, but both conditional branches constrain it as an xsd:boolean with sh:hasValue true or false. This makes the applicability test incompatible with the canonical relationship and prevents valid detached-strut structure nodes from satisfying the intended condition.
required_change: Model detached-strut use by the presence of nltl:hasDetachedStrut values, remove sh:datatype xsd:boolean and sh:hasValue true/false, and retain the detached-strut node/evidence constraints on those object values.
regression_guard: Preserve nltl:hasDetachedStrut as an object relationship to nltl:detachedStrutStructure, not as a boolean datatype property.

problem: The no-detached-strut alternative requires one nltl:hasDetachedStrut value equal to false via sh:minCount 1 and sh:hasValue false. That encodes a false literal rather than absence of the object relationship, so a ship with no detached strut cannot satisfy the normal plated-bossing alternative.
required_change: Encode the no-detached-strut condition as absence of nltl:hasDetachedStrut, for example with sh:not around a property shape requiring at least one value, while retaining the plated-bossing requirements.
regression_guard: Ensure the normal alternative is satisfied when nltl:hasDetachedStrut is absent and does not require an invented boolean value.
